chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: Automations created in the app are also manageable through the API. Supported trigger types include device_state, time_of_day, and geofence.

chunks.heading: POST /v1/automations
chunks.text:
curl -X POST https://api.nimbus.example/v1/automations \
  -d name="Porch light at dusk" \
  -d trigger_type=time_of_day -d trigger_value=sunset

chunks.heading: Listing automations
chunks.text:
curl https://api.nimbus.example/v1/automations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN"
# returns every automation for the authenticated household

chunks.heading: Deleting an automation
chunks.text:
curl -X DELETE https://api.nimbus.example/v1/automations/aut_55b2
# any routine referencing a deleted device is disabled, not deleted, per the automation limits guide
